SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.
   C. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.

2. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   C. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.
   B. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.
   D. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

6. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.
   C. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.

7. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

8. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.
   C. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..

9. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

10. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.
   B. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.
   D. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat The School as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing The School.

12. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   D. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.

13. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.
   B. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.
   C. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   B. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   D. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.

15. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   C. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.

16. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   C. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain The School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Economic activities in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Industries in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise Project at School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Peace and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
